## Weekly Plan

Lectures run Mon/Tue/Wed; with the holidays above and the mid-sem week, the semester provides **exactly 40 lecture slots — matching the syllabus's 40 hours**. Readings refer to the [primary text](./resources.qmd) (*The Principles of Diffusion Models*, arXiv:2510.21890). The plan is tentative in pacing, not in coverage.

| Week | Class days | Module · Topics |
|:---:|---|---|
| [01](weeks/w01.qmd) | Jul 29 | **M1** Course overview; generative modeling: data distributions and model families *(1 lecture)* |
| [02](weeks/w02.qmd) | Aug 3, 4, 5 | **M1** Maximum-likelihood estimation; KL divergence; empirical risk minimization |
| [03](weeks/w03.qmd) | Aug 10, 11, 12 | **M1** Challenges of high-dimensional density estimation · **M2** multivariate Gaussians |
| [04](weeks/w04.qmd) | Aug 17, 18, 19 | **M2** Conditioning & marginalization; linear transformations; discrete-time Markov chains. *CT-1 window opens Aug 19* |
| [05](weeks/w05.qmd) | Aug 24, 25 | **M2** Noise accumulation through repeated Gaussian perturbation *(no Wed class — Milad-un-Nabi)* |
| [06](weeks/w06.qmd) | Aug 31, Sep 1, 2 | **M3** DDPM: forward diffusion process; concept of the reverse process |
| [07](weeks/w07.qmd) | Sep 7, 8, 9 | **M3** Variational lower bound; decomposition of KL terms; reduction to noise-prediction loss |
| [08](weeks/w08.qmd) | Sep 14, 15, 16 | **M4** Score functions; score matching. *Mid-sem begins Fri Sep 18* |
| [09](weeks/w09.qmd) | — | **Mid-Semester Examinations (Sep 18–23)** — covers M1–M3 and W08's score-matching material |
| [10](weeks/w10.qmd) | Sep 28, 29, 30 | **M4** Denoising score matching; synthesis |
| [11](weeks/w11.qmd) | Oct 5, 6, 7 | **M5** Random walks and Brownian motion; the concept of an SDE |
| [12](weeks/w12.qmd) | Oct 12, 13, 14 | **M5** Heat-equation intuition; Fokker–Planck equation. *CT-2 window opens Oct 14* |
| [13](weeks/w13.qmd) | Oct 21 | **M5** Continuous formulation of the forward equation *(1 lecture — Mon/Tue are Dussehra holidays)* |
| [14](weeks/w14.qmd) | Oct 26, 27, 28 | **M5** wrap-up · **M6** Heuristic derivation of reverse-time drift |
| [15](weeks/w15.qmd) | Nov 2, 3, 4 | **M6** Entropy & information-flow interpretation; probability flow ODE |
| [16](weeks/w16.qmd) | — | **No classes — holidays Mon Nov 9 – Wed Nov 11 (Diwali cluster)** |
| [17](weeks/w17.qmd) | Nov 16, 17, 18 | **M6** Neural ODEs and flow-based models; applications & extensions; course wrap-up |

: {tbl-colwidths="[7,16,77]"}

::: {.callout-note}
Module hours per the syllabus: M1–M4 are 6 hours each; M5–M6 are 8 hours each (40 total). The 40 available slots cover this exactly, so any lecture lost to unforeseen events will be made up on a compensatory day.
:::
